full_prompt_en: A square painterly fantasy illustration shows a muscular blue-skinned warrior crouching on pale stone steps in an old city. He dominates the center-left, bent forward with one knee raised, shoulders broad, and a stern downward gaze. Short horn-like projections curve from his temples. His clothing is practical and worn: a brown-gray draped tunic, wide belt, shoulder covering, wrist bracers, trousers, and heavy boots. One hand grips a long sword near the hilt, with the blade slanting from left center down toward the lower right and extending near the frame edge. The other arm steadies his compact pose. Behind him, closely stacked cream and pale blue buildings rise in soft, incomplete planes: arches, balconies, walls, and windows are suggested through translucent rectangles and broken brush marks rather than fully drafted. The palette is muted, centered on chalk white, blue-gray, cyan skin, weathered tan, and small warm brown accents. Light is broad and cool, brightening the stone and the top planes of his head and arms; shadows under the tunic and between walls remain soft rather than pitch black. The figure is solidly modeled with expressive anatomy and rough edges, while the background dissolves into layered architectural atmosphere. Dry brush, scraped patches, and partially visible underdrawing keep the painting tactile. There is no blood, combat opponent, lettering, or emblem. The image feels like a quiet pause in an epic narrative, holding power in the compressed crouch and the long blade across an airy, pale urban space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画感奇幻插画呈现一名肌肉结实的蓝肤战士蹲在旧城浅石台阶上。他占据中央偏左，身体前倾，一膝抬高，肩宽，严肃地向下看。太阳穴有短角状突起。他的衣物实用且磨旧：棕灰披垂短袍、宽腰带、肩披、腕护、长裤和厚靴。一手握长剑近柄处，刃从左中部斜向右下，伸到画缘附近。另一臂稳定紧凑姿势。身后奶油与浅蓝建筑层层叠起，以柔软不完整平面出现：拱、阳台、墙与窗由半透矩形和破碎笔迹暗示，而非完全制图。色板低调，以粉笔白、蓝灰、青色皮肤、风化棕黄和少量暖褐为主。光宽而冷，照亮石头及头臂上平面；短袍下与墙间的影柔和，不是死黑。人物由富表情的解剖和粗边坚实塑形，背景却溶入层层建筑空气。干刷、刮擦块和局部可见底稿让绘画可触。没有血、战斗对手、文字或徽记。图像像史诗叙事中的安静停顿，压缩蹲姿与横贯透气浅色城市空间的长刃蕴含力量。
style_prompt_en: Painterly concept illustration sets a solidly modeled focal form against pale, partially dissolved surroundings. Blue-gray and cyan planes combine with chalk white, weathered tan, and small brown accents. Foreground structure feels expressive and weighty, with rough edges and selective sharpness, while the surrounding space becomes layered translucent blocks, dry-brush patches, and faint underdrawing. Broad cool light produces soft shadow shapes that retain volume. A long diagonal gives direction to the otherwise restrained composition. The result is tactile and atmospheric, with unfinished painterly transitions and controlled warm-cool contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画感概念插画以坚实塑形的焦点形体对照浅色、局部消散的周围空间。蓝灰与青色平面结合粉笔白、风化棕黄和少量棕色重音。前景结构富有表现力和重量感，边缘粗糙且选择性清晰；周围空间则化为层叠半透明色块、干刷斑痕和浅淡底稿。宽阔冷光形成柔和却保留体积的阴影。一道长斜形为克制的构图提供方向。整体可触而有空气感，保留未完成般的笔触过渡和节制的冷暖对比。
